Lean.ScopedEnvExtension.add.code:
Lean.ScopedEnvExtension.add {m : Type → Type} {α β σ : Type} [Monad m] [MonadResolveName m] [MonadEnv m]
  (ext : ScopedEnvExtension α β σ) (b : β) (kind : AttributeKind := AttributeKind.global) : m Unit
Lean.ScopedEnvExtension.add.fullDefinition: def ScopedEnvExtension.add [Monad m] [MonadResolveName m] [MonadEnv m] (ext : ScopedEnvExtension α β σ) (b : β) (kind := AttributeKind.global) : m Unit := do   let ns ← getCurrNamespace   modifyEnv (ext.addCore · b kind ns)
Lean.ScopedEnvExtension.add.description: A process for adding an element to a scoped environment extension within a monadic context that allows for name resolution and environment manipulation.

Lean.ScopedEnvExtension.getState.code: Lean.ScopedEnvExtension.getState {σ α β : Type} [Inhabited σ] (ext : ScopedEnvExtension α β σ) (env : Environment) : σ
Lean.ScopedEnvExtension.getState.fullDefinition: def ScopedEnvExtension.getState [Inhabited σ] (ext : ScopedEnvExtension α β σ) (env : Environment) : σ :=   match ext.ext.getState env |>.stateStack with   | top :: _ => top.state   | _        => unreachable!
Lean.ScopedEnvExtension.getState.description: A function for retrieving the current state from a scoped environment extension given a specific environment.
